title: Preferred Supplier Policy
content: Requirements must be sourced from approved suppliers where a framework agreement exists; deviations require Procurement Manager approval.

title: Capital Expenditure Threshold
content: Single items above 25,000 EUR are treated as capital expenditure and require finance sign-off before the sourcing project is approved.

title: Hazardous Materials Handling
content: Chemicals and reagents require a safety data sheet on file and a licensed carrier for transport.

title: Sourcing Project Timeline Guideline
content: Standard lab instrument sourcing runs 8 to 12 weeks from approval to delivery; consumables and office supplies typically run 2 to 4 weeks. Plan timelines accordingly.

title: Priority Assignment Guideline
content: Assign High priority when a requirement blocks active research or production, Medium for planned replacement cycles, and Low for discretionary or stock-replenishment purchases.

title: Risk Assessment Guideline
content: Assess supply risk for single-source items, lead-time risk for equipment over 8 weeks, budget risk when estimates exceed threshold, and compliance risk for chemicals and PPE.

title: Duplicate Consolidation Guideline
content: Requirements from different departments requesting the same item within one quarter should be consolidated into a single project to improve volume pricing.
